lead: My research asks how AI systems should represent individuals, simulate social dynamics, and govern interactions.
framing: I am developing a research agenda on AI-mediated societies: how information boundaries and institutional rules shape interactions among people and AI agents.

directions.title: Private Personal Intelligence
directions.description: How can personal agents use memory, preferences, and context while keeping people in control of what they disclose?

directions.title: Experimental Social Simulation
directions.description: How can simulations grounded in observations of people help us compare interventions and evaluate their effects on collective behavior?

directions.title: Institutional Agent Safety
directions.description: How can permissions, incentives, audit mechanisms, and scalable oversight govern interacting agents and protect human agency?
